title: Spaghettifying DRAM
ai_summary:
• DRAM storage cells can now be destroyed by a phenomenon called "spaghettification," where heat causes memory degradation.
• This effect occurs due to the rapid heating and subsequent failure of the DRAM's internal components.
• Researchers warn that current memory technologies may need to be reevaluated for their heat sensitivity.
student_angle: Study DRAM technologies to understand the latest advancements and future directions in memory storage.

title: Choose Boring Technology (2015)
ai_summary:

• Google advises against using complex data processing, instead focusing on proven architectures.
• The guideline promotes stability over agility, to minimize operational complexity.
student_angle: This article does not directly affect internship opportunities, but it highlights Google's emphasis on reliable solutions, indicating that entry-level engineers should focus on practical, proven technologies.
